class.name: NetwPropertyConfig
class.brief_description: Replication and persistence settings for a property.
class.description: [method state], [method input] and [method broadcast] send changed values each tick. Other properties are sent through [method Netw.sync_property]. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").state().quantize(position_q) Netw.configure_property(self, &"move_dir").input() Netw.configure_property(self, &"aim_dir").broadcast() [/codeblock] [method volatile], [method retained], [method correction_threshold] and [method persisted] apply to one property. [method heartbeat], [method windowed] and [method audience] apply to every property of the same kind on the script. Give them consistent values. [method NetwMemberConfig.interpolate] smooths received values. It returns a [NetwMemberConfig], so chain it after the methods of this class. [b]Rigid bodies[/b] When the [NetwEntity] root is a [RigidBody3D] or a [RigidBody2D], [code]position[/code], [code]quaternion[/code] ([code]rotation[/code] in 2D), [code]linear_velocity[/code], [code]angular_velocity[/code] and [code]sleeping[/code] read and write the body's physics state. [code]position[/code] stays relative to the parent. While [member RigidBody3D.freeze] is on, position and rotation use the node transform. A write to a body that stays asleep reaches peers within 30 ticks. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").state() Netw.configure_property(self, &"quaternion").state() Netw.configure_property(self, &"linear_velocity").state() [/codeblock]

method.name: audience
method.description: Sends the [method state] properties of this kind to the server only. Sets [member set_audience]. With [param server_only] [code]false[/code] it changes nothing, because state properties reach every peer unless one of them calls [method audience] and [method input] properties always reach only the server. A [method broadcast] property ignores [method audience] with a warning.

method.name: broadcast
method.description:
The controlling peer owns the value and every peer sees it, with no server check. Use it for values that only change how the entity looks, such as an aim direction. The server keeps no history of it. When a client controls the entity, or the entity is kept for a dropped player who controlled it, a spawn includes the value, so a controller that receives the node again starts from the value the server holds. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"aim_dir").broadcast()
func _process(_dt: float) -> void: aim_dir = (get_global_mouse_position() - position).normalized() [/codeblock]

method.name: correction_threshold
method.description: How far this value may drift from the server's before it is corrected, in its own units. Without it, the value uses [member NetwPrediction.correction_threshold]. [code]0.0[/code] corrects any error. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"velocity").state().correction_threshold(0.05) [/codeblock] Use [method unchecked] for a value that should never cause a correction.

method.name: correction_weight
method.description: Moves the value part of the way toward the server's value during a correction, by [param weight]. [code]0.0[/code] writes it outright. A value with no midpoint, such as a [bool], is always written outright. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"heading").state().correction_weight(0.4) [/codeblock]

method.name: extrapolate
method.description: When a correction restores this value, advances it to the present using the rate in [param rate_property]. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").state().extrapolate(&"velocity") [/codeblock] [param rate_property] must be another [method state] property of the same node.

method.name: heartbeat
method.description: Re-sends properties of this kind every [param ticks] ticks even when nothing changed, so a peer that missed a change catches up. [method input] properties ignore it. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"stunned").state().heartbeat(60) [/codeblock]

method.name: input
on_spawn
method.description: Sends the value with the spawn, and sets it on every peer before the node enters the tree, so [method Node._enter_tree] and [method Node._ready] can read it. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"pet_name").on_spawn() [/codeblock]

method.name: persisted
method.description:
Saves the server's value of this property into the [NetwEntity]'s record, whether or not it is also replicated. The saved column is named after the property, or [param saved_column_name] when given, so a property renamed later keeps its stored records by passing its old name. Two properties of one [NetwEntity] may not share a saved column name. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"gold").persisted()
Netw.configure_property(self, &"position") \ .state().persisted(&"where")
Netw.configure_property(self, &"loadout").input().persisted() [/codeblock] How often the row is saved is set with [method NetwPersistenceConfig.interval].

method.name: retained
method.description: Sends changes reliably. Use it for a value that changes rarely and must not be missed. It cannot be used on the state of a predicted [NetwEntity]. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"stunned").state().retained() [/codeblock]

method.name: state
method.description:
The server owns the value, every peer sees it, and lag compensation can rewind it. [NetwPrediction] says when an entity with a state property is predicted, and a predicted entity is corrected against this value within [method correction_threshold]. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").state().quantize(pos_q)
func _physics_process(dt: float) -> void: position += velocity * dt [/codeblock]

method.name: teleport_only
method.description: Only a teleport writes this value, and an ordinary correction leaves it alone. Pair it with [method extrapolate] so the teleport restores it at the present, or with [method unchecked] so it never causes a correction. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"angular_velocity").state().teleport_only() [/codeblock]

method.name: teleport_threshold
method.description: How large this value's error may be before a correction teleports the body, in its own units. Without it, the value uses [member NetwPrediction.teleport_threshold]. [code]0.0[/code] teleports on every correction this value causes. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").state() \ .extrapolate(&"velocity").teleport_threshold(3.0) Netw.configure_property(self, &"heading").state() \ .extrapolate(&"angular_speed").teleport_threshold(1.0) [/codeblock]

method.name: unchecked
method.description: A difference in this value never causes a correction, but a correction caused by another value still restores it. Use it for a value the body recomputes each tick or one that only affects display. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"heading").state().unchecked() [/codeblock]

method.name: windowed
method.description: Each send also includes the last [param samples] ticks of values, so the next packet makes up for a lost one. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"motion").input().windowed(3) [/codeblock]

members.member: Identifies this configuration as a property configuration.
Whether changes are sent unreliably or reliably. Set by [method volatile] and [method retained].

constants.constant: Sent unreliably. Only the newest value counts.
Sent reliably, only when it changes.
Sent to every peer that sees the [NetwEntity].
A setting no call has written yet.
